Since \(n^2 - 625 = 17p\), we have
\[
(n-25)(n+25)=17p.
\]
Both factors are positive integers, and \(n+25>n-25\). Thus the only possible factor pairings are:
\[
(n-25,n+25)=(1,17p)\quad\text{or}\quad(17,p).
\]
- If \(n-25=1\), then \(n=26\), so \(n+25=51=17p\), giving \(p=3\).
- If \(n-25=17\), then \(n=42\), so \(n+25=67=p\).

The largest prime is therefore
\[
\boxed{67}
\]
